Segoe UI isn't installed on this device, so a similar font is used. For an exact match, make your signature on a Windows PC.

Faded text is example text and is replaced as you type. The dashed lines only show here and are not in the saved images.

  1. Download both saves …-top.png and …-bottom.png. You can also copy each one on its own.
  2. Outlook on the web: Settings › Accounts › Signatures. Paste the top image, press Shift+Enter, then paste the bottom image.
  3. To link the top image to the website, click it, press Ctrl+K and enter https://bigfootgroups.com.
  1. Copy signature copies the whole signature with its links built in. The top image goes to the website and each social icon goes to its own page.
  2. Outlook on the web: Settings › Accounts › Signatures. Delete any old signature, paste (Ctrl+V) and save.
  3. Send yourself a test email and click each icon to check the links.
